background_templates.name: Forest Glow
background_templates.description: A soft green card background with forest leaf textures and glow accents.

background_templates.name: Stream Splash
background_templates.description: A cool blue water card backdrop with subtle current lines and splash details.

background_templates.name: Sunshine Halo
background_templates.description: A bright golden card frame with warm sun flares and floral highlights.

organisms.name: Ladybird beetle
organisms.description: A small beetle with hard wing covers. Many ladybirds eat aphids; their colors and spots vary.
organisms.notes: A suggested visual category. It may include similar-looking organisms; verify with a trusted field guide.
organisms.safety_message: Do not pick it up or disturb the plant it is on.

organisms.name: Bee
organisms.description: Bees visit flowers to collect pollen and nectar. Some live in colonies, while many live alone.
organisms.habitat: Flower-rich gardens, meadows, and other habitats
organisms.notes: A suggested visual category. It may include similar-looking organisms; verify with a trusted field guide.
organisms.safety_message: Stay away from nests. Bees can sting; observe without touching.

organisms.name: Ant
organisms.description: Ants have elbowed antennae and live in colonies. Workers gather food and care for the nest.
organisms.habitat: Soil, leaf litter, trees, and many other habitats
organisms.environment_role: Moves soil, disperses seeds, and recycles nutrients
organisms.notes: A suggested visual category. It may include similar-looking organisms; verify with a trusted field guide.
organisms.safety_message: Do not disturb the nest. Some ants bite or sting.

organisms.name: Grasshopper
organisms.description: Grasshoppers have strong hind legs for jumping. Most eat plants and are food for many birds and other animals.
organisms.environment_role: Connects plants and predators in food webs
organisms.notes: A suggested visual category. It may include similar-looking organisms; verify with a trusted field guide.
organisms.safety_message: Watch where it lands without grabbing it.

organisms.name: Praying mantis
organisms.description: Mantises have grasping front legs and usually wait quietly for prey. They eat other small animals.
organisms.habitat: Vegetation in gardens, grasslands, and woodland
organisms.notes: A suggested visual category. It may include similar-looking organisms; verify with a trusted field guide.
organisms.safety_message: Do not handle it or interfere with its prey.

organisms.name: Dragonfly
organisms.description: Dragonflies usually rest with their wings spread. Their young live in water and adults hunt flying insects.
organisms.habitat: Ponds, streams, wetlands, and nearby vegetation
organisms.notes: A suggested visual category. It may include similar-looking organisms; verify with a trusted field guide.
organisms.safety_message: Stay on safe paths near water. Ask an adult before approaching a pond or stream.

organisms.name: Damselfly
organisms.description: Damselflies are slender relatives of dragonflies. Most rest with their wings together, and their young live in water.
organisms.notes: A suggested visual category. It may include similar-looking organisms; verify with a trusted field guide.
organisms.safety_message: Stay on safe paths near water. Observe its delicate wings without touching.

organisms.name: Monarch butterfly
organisms.description: Monarch butterflies have orange wings with black veins and borders. Their caterpillars feed on milkweed.
organisms.habitat: Open areas with flowers and milkweed
organisms.environment_role: Flower visitor and part of food webs
organisms.notes: A suggested visual category. It may include similar-looking organisms; verify with a trusted field guide.
organisms.safety_message: Do not touch butterflies or taste milkweed. Similar-looking butterflies can be confused with monarchs.

organisms.name: Cabbage white butterfly group
organisms.description: Several white butterflies in this group have dark markings. Their caterpillars often feed on plants in the cabbage family.
organisms.habitat: Gardens, fields, and open grassy areas
organisms.environment_role: Flower visitor and food for predators
organisms.notes: A suggested visual category. It may include similar-looking organisms; verify with a trusted field guide.
organisms.safety_message: Do not touch its wings. This category does not distinguish the species in the group.

organisms.name: Snail
organisms.description: Snails move on a muscular foot and carry a shell. Different kinds live on land, in freshwater, or in the sea.
organisms.habitat: Species-dependent: damp land, freshwater, or sea
organisms.environment_role: Grazer, recycler, or predator depending on species
organisms.notes: A suggested visual category. It may include similar-looking organisms; verify with a trusted field guide.
organisms.safety_message: Do not handle or eat it. Wash your hands if you accidentally touch it.

organisms.name: Slug
organisms.description: Slugs are gastropods with reduced or absent external shells. Many land slugs are active in damp conditions.
organisms.habitat: Often damp gardens, woods, and leaf litter
organisms.environment_role: Recycler or plant eater depending on species
organisms.notes: A suggested visual category. It may include similar-looking organisms; verify with a trusted field guide.
organisms.safety_message: Do not handle or eat it. Wash your hands if you accidentally touch it.

organisms.name: Daisy-like flower
organisms.description: A daisy-like flower head is made of many tiny flowers. The center and surrounding rays may look like one flower.
organisms.notes: A suggested visual category. It may include similar-looking organisms; verify with a trusted field guide.
organisms.safety_message: Do not pick, taste, or use it as medicine. This visual category is not a species identification.
